description: Snow peaks catching first light above a still, misty mountain lake.
Amer fort floodlit gold on its hill, mirrored in maota lake at night.
Aurora curtains rippling over a still fjord, a cabin lit on the shore.
The vercel triangle as a glass prism, splitting white light to a rainbow.
The sun sinks into a drifting sea of orange cloud at dusk.
A night city whose boulevards trace the command key in streetlight.
Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.
The milky way over a lone acacia on moonless dunes, meteors falling.
The earth rising over a cratered lunar horizon in long low sunlight.
The night earth from orbit, cloudflare requests arcing city to city.
Udaipur at night, a lit gateway on lake pichola and diyas on the water.
A thunderstorm at sea, the lightning striking in the supabase bolt.
The jaipur water palace floating on a misty lake at sunrise.
A tiered waterfall in a rainforest gorge, spray, a rainbow and macaws.
Sankranti kites crowding a golden sky over the pink roofs of jaipur.
A pagoda at dusk behind a cherry tree lit by a stone lantern.
Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
Sky lanterns rising over a still mountain lake, one let go from a boat.
A wall of lava lamps under the glowing orange cloud, watched by a camera.
Mumbai's queen's necklace at night, lamps curving round the bay.
Pine ridges fading into morning fog, sunbeams slanting through.
A lighthouse turning its beam under moonlit clouds over a dark sea.
A desert highway at dusk, rushing toward the mountains and last light.
The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
A dark planet cut into the planetscale mark, backlit, a moon circling.
A black spire and an orange cloud over a blue hour city and its river.
The vercel triangle over a mirror of salt, the sun rising behind its tip.
Saturn and its rings hanging over the cracked ice and geysers of a moon.
A lit train crossing a snowy stone viaduct at night as snow falls.
An anvil thunderhead at dusk flickering over a wheat field.
The taj mahal at sunrise, mirrored in its pool through morning haze.
A tokyo side street in the rain, neon signs shining on the wet road.
Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
A volcano erupting at night, lava rivers, an ash plume full of lightning.
A golden silhouette, with a point of light at the heart that blooms and recedes.
